thread.title: Need help with getting added to submission
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Hi my group made a submission entitled "Measuring and Steering Ambiguity Handling in Language Models" (submission 29) and the group member that added me supposedly my gmail (andyzorigin@gmail.com) instead of my berkeley.edu (andyzh@berkeley.edu) so it does not display on my console. I'm aware and have sent that group member instructions to add me (from https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/docs/help/author/edit-co-authors.html) though they stated that the edit submission button has disappeared.</paragraph><paragraph>Would you mind helping edit the submission to add my berkeley account so that I would be able to see it displayed on the dashboard?</paragraph></document>
thread.document:
Hi my group made a submission entitled "Measuring and Steering Ambiguity Handling in Language Models" (submission 29) and the group member that added me supposedly my gmail (andyzorigin@gmail.com) instead of my berkeley.edu (andyzh@berkeley.edu) so it does not display on my console. I'm aware and have sent that group member instructions to add me (from https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/docs/help/author/edit-co-authors.html) though they stated that the edit submission button has disappeared.

Would you mind helping edit the submission to add my berkeley account so that I would be able to see it displayed on the dashboard?

comments.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>To my knowledge, there is no way for us to edit the author list of submissions.  You can try linking the CMT accounts for those emails. If you log into one of your accounts, you should be able to add other emails, then submissions under both emails will appear together.</paragraph></document>
comments.document: To my knowledge, there is no way for us to edit the author list of submissions.  You can try linking the CMT accounts for those emails. If you log into one of your accounts, you should be able to add other emails, then submissions under both emails will appear together.

comments.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Sounds good, I linked the two accounts and can access the submission (though I need to enter the linked email author console; I tried to merge but it hasn't worked yet and says it'll take 1-2 business days). Is there anything else I need to do on my end? Just want to make sure that things will be fine for grading etc.</paragraph><paragraph>Thanks for the help!</paragraph></document>
